purpose: Retroactive provenance manifest for pipeline runs run42/run43/run44/run45/run46/run47/run48, whose backing pipeline configs were edited in place after each run (fixed_camera confidence=0.1 -> uav_motion count-bypass -> traffic_normal.mp4 checks), so the current content of configs/pipeline/offline_video_stillness_lowconf_test.yaml no longer reproduces run42. This manifest is the authoritative record of what each run actually used; the config files under configs/pipeline/ are working copies, not frozen experiment definitions like configs/experiments/*.yaml.
provenance_gap_disclosed: run.json for each of these runs already embeds the exact parameters used at that time (perception.confidence, analytics.mode, roi_polygon, etc. -- see each run's own run.json), so no run's OWN result is in doubt. What was missing, and what this file fixes, is a single external, hash-backed, non-overwritten record that does not depend on the mutable config file still matching. output/pipeline/ is gitignored, so run.json/summary.json/analytics.csv themselves are not committed; this manifest carries the load-bearing numbers instead.

runs.label: Test 1: lower confidence alone, occupancy corroboration intact
runs.note: DENSE reached (up from 54/900 at confidence=0.4), CONGESTED never reached. Compare against the original run38 (confidence=0.4, same source/ROI): DENSE only 54/900.

runs.label: Test 2: lower confidence + drop occupancy co-requirement (analytics.mode: uav_motion) -- REJECTED, kept for the record
runs.note: Looked like a strong fix on this clip (93% CONGESTED, single clean transition), but see run44 -- rejected after a false-positive check.

runs.label: False-positive check of run43's config on a genuinely light-traffic clip -- FAILED, this is why run43 is rejected
runs.note: 79% false-positive CONGESTED on a reference clip explicitly named/curated as normal traffic. roi_track_count (100-122) was comparable to or higher than the jam clip's (64-94) despite genuinely light traffic; bbox_union_occupancy correctly stayed low (0.06-0.11 vs the jam clip's 0.15-0.32) -- occupancy, not count, is the signal that actually separates these two real scenes.

runs.label: Same false-positive check with run42's (safe) config instead -- PASSED
runs.note: Correctly NORMAL for all 300 frames with occupancy corroboration intact, same confidence and ROI as run44 -- isolates that occupancy corroboration, not confidence, was what run43 unsafely dropped.

runs.label: Additional false-positive check: light, sparse traffic clip
runs.note: vid3 is a dataset test-split source (datasets/vietnam_dataset_v5/manifest.csv: source_id=vid3, split=test). confidence=0.1 was already fixed from run42 (a train-split clip) before this run; this is a one-time confirmatory check on a test-split video, not used to further tune the threshold -- consistent with docs/dataset_protocol.md's rule against selecting on the locked test.

runs.label: Additional false-positive check: busy but flowing traffic
runs.note: Occupancy (0.25) sits just under the 0.30 DENSE entry threshold on a visibly busy-but-moving street; visually consistent with NORMAL, not an obvious miss.

runs.label: Additional false-positive check: native drone source, light traffic
runs.note: The project's one native UAV drone source (see readme.md Dataset section); light traffic, correctly NORMAL.

conclusion.adopted: fixed_camera mode, perception.confidence=0.1, occupancy co-requirement intact -- a real, partial improvement (run42), zero false positives across 5 real clips (run42 jam clip + run45/46/47/48).
conclusion.rejected: analytics.mode: uav_motion as a way to let roi_track_count alone trigger CONGESTED without occupancy corroboration (run43) -- gave 79% false-positive CONGESTED on traffic_normal.mp4 (run44). Root cause: count does not distinguish a wide view with many flowing vehicles from a genuinely packed, stalled scene; occupancy corroboration exists for exactly that reason.
conclusion.still_open: 73% of the motivating clip (run42) still reports NORMAL despite the crowd being visibly packed from frame 0 (confirmed persistent, not building up -- see the activity-mask result in docs/benchmark_protocol.md). Closing that gap needs a different signal (a dedicated low-confidence density pass, or a better texture feature), not further threshold tuning on this same signal set.

caveat: This is 7 pipeline runs across 5 clips at one confidence/ROI setting each, not a frame-level annotated congestion benchmark. 'Zero false positives' means no false CONGESTED/DENSE state transition was observed on 4 clips chosen as known-non-congested by content/title, not a measured false-positive RATE against ground truth -- there is no frame-level congestion ground truth for any of these clips.
